caption: This drawing depicts a lidded cylindrical container, likely made of metal, identified by its shiny, reflective surface and metallic brown coloration with areas of golden yellow highlights suggesting tarnish or patina. The container has a rounded lid with a knob at the top that has vertical ridges, and the lid flares outward slightly at the edges. The main body of the container is straight-sided and rests on a circular, raised base. Two symmetrical handles are attached to either side of the container near the top, each curved and stylized with a decorative form. The composition centers the container on a light, plain background, with no additional objects or scenery present. The name "Robert Stewart" is written in brown text near the lower right corner of the drawing.
